about_the_game: This is a game that allows you to simulate tennis gameplay in real-time online matches. It supports cross-platform play, even between desktop and mobile devices, with both singles and doubles modes available. Each character has a unique appearance. The game is already prepared for free-form building and dynamic lighting scenes. In the future, you will be able to manage a tennis club or play as an independent tennis player. The goal of this game is to simulate the entire tennis world.

short_description: This is a tennis-themed open-world game. From managing or joining a tennis club to every swing and movement on the court, you have full control.
